source_seed: created by the current run's V35 noise-search stage from the current task_spec
pipeline: recognize wall_brush task and generate task_spec.json
generate current-run native multi-prompt samples from task_spec constraints
score current-run native samples and select seed_B
run V35 noise-search from current-run seed_B and select seed_C
run V36 soft full-body projection only on current-run seed_C
apply temporal continuity smoothing with lambda 5.0

generalization_validation.rule: Each variant must run the same from-scratch prompt->task_spec->native generation->rerank->current-run seed_C->soft full-body projection->continuity filter pipeline; do not reuse an old seed_C or old best npz.

notes: Do not treat this as only a saved seed or saved npz. The reproducible default process is defined in full_pipeline_spec and starts from prompt + native constraints.
The current default wall-brush generation flow does not use an old seed_C as input.
seed_C is an intermediate artifact generated from the current task_spec by the V35 stage.
The generic V36 research script can still run seed A/B/C for comparison, but the from-scratch default selected pipeline uses the current-run seed_C with --only_seed seed_C.
This is not right-arm FABRIK, not line IK, and not return IK.
Use it as the default visual wall-brush method unless the user asks for native no-IK only.
